title: Isandro and the Interior
author: Juniper Coldharbour
blurb: Tamsin Nystrom, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the demolition date arrives.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
